h1: WaterSound "The Crossings, Unit 110C" 100 South Bridge Lane 110C
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private deeded beach access- Gulf views- 3 Adult bikes- Fantastic porch spaces- Pool and beach are just yards away- Community fitness center and parks- Garage- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*This property comes with 1 dedicated parking space in the driveway, and 1 first-come, first-served parking space within the community. Please note that first-come, first-served parking is limited and not guaranteed. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Beginning in March 2025 and continuing through 2026, the WaterSound Crossings condominiums will undergo an extensive exterior refurbishment project. During this period, residents and guests should expect significant construction activity, including the boarding of windows and restricted access to balconies in affected buildings. These measures are necessary to ensure safety and facilitate the successful completion of the work.DETAILS: Indulge in a relaxing escape at Unit 110C. This charming 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom coastal condo is nestled within the gated WaterSound community, sleeping up to 8 guests and welcoming 2 dogs. Guests enjoy breathtaking Gulf views, a beautiful shared pool, and dedicated access to the pristine beach—only a short stroll down the boardwalk! With The Big Chill’s shopping, dining, and family-friendly fun within walking distance, plus numerous adventure options nearby, including kayaking, fishing, and nature hikes, this retreat offers a perfect base for an Iconic 30A vacation!Laid-back elegance reigns inside this 2-level home, adorned with classic wainscoting and warm hardwood floors. On the first level, guests will find an inviting entryway and a convenient laundry room with a sink for easily refreshing swimwear. Rest comfortably in the primary bedroom, which features a luxurious king bed, a private bathroom, and an expansive porch space. Kids will love the cozy sleeping nook with a twin-over-twin bunk bed.Upstairs, views of the resplendent Gulf welcome guests to the spacious great room. Gather together in the well-appointed living space, with plenty of soft seating and a TV, to unwind after a day in the sun. The kitchen boasts granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a pass-through to the 2-stool breakfast bar—perfect for visiting with guests at the 4-person table or admiring the view while cooking. Out the glass doors, a sprawling covered balcony with sun loungers, additional seating, and gorgeous Gulf views—start the day with a fragrant cup of coffee in the fresh coastal air! This level’s sleeping accommodations include 2 lovely guest bedrooms with 1 queen bed in the first bedroom and 2 twin beds in the second.Experience a rejuvenating WaterSound getaway with easy beach access, leisurely pool days, and awe-inspiring Gulf views at Unit 110C. Parking is available for up to 2 vehicles, with 1 dedicated driveway parking spot, making it easy to explore the area’s stunning state parks and celebrated communities, including neighboring Seagrove and Seacrest Beaches. For beach access, simply follow the boardwalk at the back of the building. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guests of guests are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*We are happy to welcome up to 2 dogs for an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.*Property Enhancement Notice: This unit is being extensively renovated with a brand-new kitchen, all-new bathrooms, and upgraded sleeping accommodations featuring king beds in every bedroom. Renovation photos will be added as updates are completed.
